description: Validate a UEF 2.0 document (object or JSON string): the published schema (schema_version 2.x, known keys, types, required fields, phases), every ref resolving to a record in the document, no repeated ref or external_id, and the gig rules import applies (a ref or an inline venue/client, end_date not before event_date, multi-day gigs carry dates only, days inside the gig, HH:MM cue times). Returns valid, errors with paths such as events[0].days[1].date, missing_required paths, and schema_version. Deterministic and local — no AI, no org write, no invented fixes. Input is capped at 256 KiB.

uef.description: UEF document as object or JSON string

name: validate_uef

data.description: tool payload (API/composite/confirmation object); object, array, or primitive JSON

title: Validate UEF
